QuestInfo.name: Luden's Warning 3
QuestInfo.0: #p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
QuestInfo.1: To find out what #p2161002# wants to teach you, you must first get #rat least 1 #t2049400# or #t2049401##k from  #r#t2430558##k, which you can get by defeating #o8210013# at Ani's Jail.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161002# taught you how to unlock hidden potentials on regular equipment by using the Potential Scroll.

0.0: There are many ways a warrior like yourself can become stronger, but some of them may not be known to you!\r\n#L0##bReally? I'm pretty sure I got this all figured out...#l\n#k
0.1: You believe so, do you? Then you must do something to prove that you still have room to learn. What do you say?

yes.0: You are wise to proceed. First, obtain #rat least 1 #t2049400# or #t2049401##k from #r#t2430558##k. You will have to face #o8210013# to get one.

no.0: Talk to me again when you're prepared. You must be strong enough to face our king!

1.0: Ah, so you've found a #rPotential Scroll#k already! How fortunate! It has a rather interesting power that lesser scrolls lack.
1.1: First, you can only use Potential Scrolls on #ritems of normal rank#k. When used, #ra randomly selected rank and hidden potential will be added to your equipment#k, giving you a significant boost in performance.
1.2: Once an equipment has been blessed by a Potential Scroll, you will not be able to use another. If your luck is good, you will get the configuration you desire. There is a box of some sort that can reset these potentials, but I have no knowledge of it.

yes.0: I have shared all the knowledge I can of the Potential Scroll. I hope its power will be enough to aid you in stopping our fallen king.
